description: He wears an opaque deep plum long coat with full sleeves and tan-gold woven geometric borders at the front opening, cuffs and below-knee hem. A cream undertunic shows through the narrow opening and at the wrists. Round brass-toned clasps close the neckline and attach a matching draped shoulder cloth at one side. A wide patterned belt closes with a round decorated buckle. Dark brown trousers tuck into dark brown calf-high leather boots. A plain finger ring is visible. No headgear or weapon is visible.
